resources.string: To do
%1$d/%2$d done
Tap a step to open its screen. Turn it on, then come back.
Allow auto-start
Turn KidGuard on there, then tap Done. Otherwise the phone stops it in the background.
Done
On the KidGuard page, turn on Auto launch, then tap Done. Otherwise the phone stops KidGuard in the background.
Let KidGuard run in the background
Open Battery and choose No restrictions or Allow background activity. Then tap Done.
Lock KidGuard in Recents
Hold the KidGuard card and choose Lock. Swiping the card away stops KidGuard.
Kid Home
The kid home screen: only allowed apps, today\'s time left, SOS and a \"Today\" page.

adb port 5555
Does NOT come back on mobile data. On Wi-Fi it reopens within ~10 min, or when a parent taps Open now. Or plug into a computer and run: adb tcpip 5555
VPN (Tailscale)
